deployment_rules.express_requirements: Requires VP Engineering sign-off and dedicated solutions architect allocation
deployment_rules.two_week_rejection_reason: Veridian VPC peering, IAM role setup, and automated data pipeline validation require at least 21 business days. A 2-week timeline creates catastrophic deployment failure risk.

pricing_and_discount_rules.policy_note: A 40% discount ($43,200) requires CEO approval and is strictly forbidden without a 3-year upfront commitment.

security_compliance_rules.soc2_type_ii_requirement: Mandatory delivery and mutual security team review before any production data ingestion or staging VPC access.
security_compliance_rules.pen_test_summary: Available upon request under mutual NDA.
